Byte-by-byte Description of file: datafile2.txt
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   Bytes Format Units     Label                   Explanations
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   1-  4 I4     K         Temp      Gas temperature 
   6- 10 E5.0   0.1PA     Pressure  Gas pressure in units of dyne/cm^2^

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Note (1): For [M/H] = +0.3, compared to solar abundances of Lodders (2003).
